correctness.rationale: The named symbols are unit vectors 1,2,4. A minimal recovery subset is independent (otherwise one column could be dropped from its span), has at most three positions, and in a binary independent set uses every column in the target expression. Zero columns thus never occur in a minimal recovery and can be deleted. The frozen exchange peeling computes the greatest exchange-closed triple family: a triple with a missing label over one of its faces cannot be in any such subfamily, and a nonempty stable core satisfies the cited exchange criterion. Reproduced by a different state-space computation using `python3 -B /workspace/reviews/replay_1.py /workspace/source/2026/10/13/sharp-length-and-complete-optimizer-classification-for-three-req--42981a3371a2`. It builds independent sets by updating the span and solves a safety game on all disjoint histories of sizes 0 to 3. A state survives if every legal completion of one process stays in the surviving family, and each possible request label when there is a free slot has some surviving successor. Multiple completions are successive deletions. States removed in a given round can be forced to a failure in finitely many moves by an adverse deletion or arrival label, while the fixed point gives a policy. The empty state wins for 0 of 1716 length-7 multisets and 79 of 3003 length-8 multisets. Any shorter encoder would extend to seven by appending unused coordinates, and any length-8 winner with a zero column would shorten; no such cases are omitted. Winning entails full row rank because all named unit vectors are recoverable. The independent replay checked the exact 79 keys and all minimal-mask strong selections from witnesses.json against every disjoint chosen history of size 0, 1 or 2. It checked all 17 actual displayed table rows, with ten size-six, six size-three and one size-one orbit, and profile counts 48,24,7. The frozen verifier was inspected as evidence, not executed. The equivalence only permutes storage coordinates and, for the orbit statement, message labels; not arbitrary information bases.

value.rationale: Shortest length for small dimension and at least three active requests is an explicit prior research question. The first parameter beyond two active requests gives a meaningful model separator from the static length-six case. The complete list and the existence of a strong policy family for each optimum identify design options and resolve a model comparison exactly at the minimum, rather than merely reproducing an existing construction. No extension to longer lengths or other dimensions is claimed.
